title: hypochaeris glabra subsp. arachnoides
intro: Hypochaeris glabra subsp. arachnoides, commonly known as False Hawkbit, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). The health benefits of Hypochaeris glabra subsp. arachnoides include its potential use in reducing inflammation and improving digestive health, although more research is needed to confirm these effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. However, the bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions have not been extensively studied, making further research necessary to identify and characterize them fully.
